title: anatomapa: a Python library for anatomical heatmaps of the human body surface
description:
Python library for generating anatomical heatmaps of the human body surface, in anterior and posterior views, coloring regions by frequency, intensity or density of events. It accepts input as a dictionary, CSV, JSON or spreadsheet, and exports to SVG, PNG and JPEG.

The core has no external dependencies, relying only on the Python standard library, and the output is deterministic: the same input always produces the exact same file.

Biblioteca Python para gerar mapas de calor anatômicos da superfície externa do corpo humano, nas vistas anterior e posterior, colorindo regiões por frequência, intensidade ou densidade de eventos. O núcleo não possui dependências externas e a saída é determinística.

Credits: Pedro Rosa (development and creation); Marcelo Reis (Professor of the Graduate Program in Environmental Systems Analysis, CESMAC); Mozart Melo (coordination and supervision, CESMAC).
